newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-Neste Jan-April profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Neste Jan-April profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 431 million markka median forecast for Finnish oil, chemicals and energy group Neste Oy's January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecasts by 12 analysts, EPS by six analysts).
Neste's four-month results are due on June 11 at 0900/0600 GMT.
In January-April 1996, Neste posted a profit before extraordinaries and tax of 219 million markka.
In February, Neste said it expected its performance in 1997 to improve despite uncertainty over price developments in its markets.

The median of nine analysts' forecasts for Neste's full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 1.29 billion markka (mean 1.24 billion) in a range from 895 million to 1.53 billion markka. In 1996, Neste's profit was 566 million markka.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities and Postipankki.
